propositions: Hardcoded reconciler mappings in Jira adapter files must be refactored into a provider-neutral, config-driven foundation before individual axes can be made configurable.
[tool.rebar.mapping] must be registered as a reserved config section alongside llm and snapshot, parsed raw without triggering unknown-key warnings, and readable via read_reserved_section.

Axis maps (status_map, type_map, link_map, priority_map, create_defaults) must deep-merge per key across three layers (built-in defaults, config default block, project-specific block) with most-specific layer winning; vocabulary declarations (statuses, issue_types, link_types, hierarchy) must replace wholesale, not union.

Configuration validation must fail closed offline with MappingConfigError when axis-map values fall outside declared vocabularies, malformed sub-tables are present, or capability-absent axes are referenced.

A provider-neutral Capability descriptor must declare which mapping axes a target supports (has_types, has_transitions, has_hierarchy, has_link_types, has_priorities), gating which axes are valid for validation.
